description.narrative: Country portfolio budget - CPB Lesotho 2019-2024 Support the Government in evidence-based planning, design, management and implementation of social protection programmes, including by handing over the home-grown school meals programme

sector.narrative: By 2030, end hunger and ensure access by all people, in particular the poor and people in vulnerable situations, including infants, to safe, nutritious and sufficient food all year round
